_comment: Scope excludes for relevance (dir_1784414113380). A tender is relevant if its UNSPSC family is in the relevant set (secop_unspsc_families) AND its objeto/nombre does NOT match any of these fragments. These are accent-folded, lowercased substrings matched against lower(nombre||descripcion) — write them accent-free. They kill the observed noise (interventoría de obras, hardware supply, industrial/physical maintenance, reselling) so the worker never wastes Claude tokens on out-of-scope tenders. Edit freely; restart the bridge to apply.
